title: Abdominal Ultrasound
text:
Abdomen US

Liver: Parenchymal echogenicity 증가, mild to moderate fatty liver. Focal lesion 없음.
GB: 4 mm sized nonshadowing echogenic polyp, fundus. Wall thickening 없음.
CBD: 4 mm, 정상.
Pancreas: 보이는 범위 내 특이 소견 없음.
Spleen: 10.2 cm.
Both kidneys: 정상 크기, hydronephrosis 없음.

Imp)
1. Fatty liver, mild-moderate.
2. GB polyp 4 mm - 크기 작아 f/u 불필요 (SRU 2022 consensus 기준).
teaches: Normal report: 'f/u 불필요'. MedGemma quoted it; the check removes it.
